Notepik rolls out lifetime AI meeting assistant plan, promising automatic notes and task extraction

03 Nov 2026, 06:33 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: deals.bleepingcomputer.com

4 min read

Key takeawaysOverall, Notepik’s lifetime plan bundles a suite of AI‑driven meeting utilities into a single, non‑recurring purchase. Prospective buyers should weigh the convenience of automated notes against the unverified claims about language coverage and citation accuracy, and verify the product through official channels and user feedback before deployment.

Image: deals.bleepingcomputer.com · Photo source · Resized and letterboxed to 16:9; no AI generation

In this article
  1. Overview
  2. Confirmed Features (as described by the vendor)
  3. Reported Claims (vendor‑provided, not independently verified)
  4. Practical Implications for Teams
  5. How to Verify the Offer
  6. Limitations and Unknowns

Overview

Notepik, an AI‑powered meeting assistant, has announced a lifetime subscription that bundles its core features with three user seats and five hours of meeting processing each month. The offer is marketed through a deal site and is positioned as a way to turn every virtual call into a searchable summary, a decision log, and a list of actionable items.

Confirmed Features (as described by the vendor)

  • Bot‑based join: A visible Notepik bot can enter Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls via a shared link or calendar sync.
  • Chrome extension: Users may record a meeting directly in the browser without the bot, and can also upload pre‑recorded audio/video files up to 2 GB.
  • Transcription & summarisation: The service generates a transcript and a concise summary, with multilingual support for more than 40 languages.
  • Action‑item extraction: Each identified next step is paired with a suggested owner and due date, then pushed to Slack, Asana, Trello, ClickUp, HubSpot, or custom webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n).
  • Decision log: Key decisions are captured in a searchable library shared across the three seats.
  • Export options: Summaries can be downloaded as Markdown or PDF files.
  • Platform‑agnostic web app: Works in any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, iOS, or Android; no dedicated desktop or mobile app is required.
  • Usage limits: The lifetime plan includes 5 hours of meeting processing per month (roughly 5‑10 average calls). Unused hours do not roll over, and processing pauses when the limit is reached until the next month.

Reported Claims (vendor‑provided, not independently verified)

  • “Multilingual summaries in 40+ languages” – Notepik states the AI can produce summaries in the language spoken during the call.
  • “Ask with citations” – Users can query past meetings and receive answers that cite the exact moment in the transcript.
  • “Custom summary templates” – The platform allegedly allows different formats for sales calls, stand‑ups, and hiring interviews.
  • “No overage charges” – The company claims that exceeding the monthly hour limit simply pauses processing rather than incurring extra fees.

Practical Implications for Teams

  • Reduced manual note‑taking: Teams that already use Zoom, Teams, or Webex can let Notepik capture the conversation, freeing participants to focus on discussion.
  • Centralised task tracking: By automatically routing action items to existing project‑management tools, the assistant could streamline hand‑offs and reduce missed follow‑ups.
  • Searchable knowledge base: The shared library makes it easier to locate past decisions without digging through disparate meeting recordings.
  • Cost predictability: A one‑time payment eliminates recurring subscription fees, which may appeal to small businesses or startups on tight budgets.

How to Verify the Offer

  1. Visit Notepik’s official website and locate the “Lifetime” plan page; compare pricing and feature lists with the deal‑site description.
  2. Check independent reviews on platforms such as G2, Capterra, or Reddit for user experiences regarding transcription accuracy and integration reliability.
  3. Test the free tier or trial (if available) before committing to the lifetime code to confirm browser compatibility and bot behaviour.
  4. Confirm the redemption process – the code must be entered within 30 days, and only one code can be applied per workspace.

Limitations and Unknowns

  • Accuracy of AI transcription and summarisation has not been benchmarked by third‑party studies; real‑world performance may vary by accent, audio quality, or language.
  • Security and compliance: Notepik does not hold HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 certifications, making it unsuitable for clinical, legally privileged, or HR disciplinary conversations.
  • No live captioning: The service does not provide real‑time captions during calls, which could be a barrier for accessibility needs.
  • Device limits: While the web app is unrestricted, the lack of a native mobile app may affect users who prefer on‑the‑go note‑taking.

Overall, Notepik’s lifetime plan bundles a suite of AI‑driven meeting utilities into a single, non‑recurring purchase. Prospective buyers should weigh the convenience of automated notes against the unverified claims about language coverage and citation accuracy, and verify the product through official channels and user feedback before deployment.
